context: A boss reviews an R&D update from his manager
purpose: Teach: メモリ/スピーカー/計測/走行/適応/バイオ/有機/コア

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ケンジ君、新型ロボットのコア部分の開発はどこまで進んでいる？
lines.en: Kenji, how far along is the development of the new robot's core component?
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening with direct managerial inquiry

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、有機素材を使ったバイオセンサーの統合がほぼ完了しました。
lines.en: Yes, the integration of bio-sensors using organic materials is nearly complete.
lines.style: Respectful subordinate giving a formal technical progress update

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それは素晴らしい。実機の走行テストの結果はどうだった？
lines.en: That's excellent. How were the results of the actual unit's driving tests?
lines.style: Pleased executive following up with pointed performance question

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 走行距離は順調ですが、メモリの消費量を正確に計測したところ、想定より多いことが判明しまして。
lines.en: The driving distance is fine, but when we precisely measured memory consumption, it turned out higher than expected.
lines.style: Hedging engineer carefully delivering mixed news to superior

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ふむ、それは気になるな。環境への適応はうまくいっているのか？
lines.en: Hmm, that's concerning. Is the environmental adaptation going well?
lines.style: Thoughtful boss probing deeper into technical concerns

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 適応アルゴリズムは良好で、内蔵スピーカーからの音声出力も安定しています。
lines.en: The adaptation algorithm is performing well, and audio output from the built-in speaker is also stable.
lines.style: Reassuring manager providing balanced positive technical detail

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 了解した。来週の役員会議までに改善案をまとめておいてくれ。
lines.en: Understood. Have an improvement proposal ready by next week's executive meeting.
lines.style: Decisive boss closing with a clear actionable directive
